answer_1.quote: Adversarial testing here is conducted by human red teamers, in a multi-turn (mean: 16.4 ± 11.3 turns) setting.
answer_1.outputs: multi-turn dialogues where red teamers attempt to steer the model into violating safety rules related to hate speech and discriminatory stereotypes

answer_4.quote: Two annotators rate each dialogue on whether the targeted rule was broken on a four-point Likert scale. In addition to their rating, they provide freetext reasoning to explain their rating.
answer_4.guideline: whether the model violated a specific rule from the safety policy, particularly rules about hate speech and discriminatory stereotypes against demographic groups
